subject: Pre-existing: tests/test_errors_and_logging.py fails after the db suite in one run (loggers disabled)
body: Running 'pytest -m "db or not integration"' in one process, 3 tests in tests/test_errors_and_logging.py fail with an empty log capture (they pass alone, and they fail with tests/auth deselected). Likely cause: Aegra's alembic env.py (run in-process by naadi_api.agent.migrate_all during db tests) calls logging.config.fileConfig with the default disable_existing_loggers=True, which disables already-created loggers such as naadi.request. naadi_api/migrations/env.py passes disable_existing_loggers=False. CI is unaffected today because the checks job (not integration) and the db job (-m db) run separately. Suggest re-enabling loggers after the Aegra migration in migrate_all (for name in logging.root.manager.loggerDict: logger.disabled = False) or running it in a subprocess.
